notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.56
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][p][b]UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.56[/b]
[b]Release Date: September 19, 2025[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Trap Added[/b]
A brand-new trap has been introduced to the game. No spoilers here… it’s up to you to discover it 😉.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Level Change Despite Gas Fixed[/b]
Fixed a bug where players could still change levels even without expeditions left and while gas was present.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Syringe Position Fix[/b]
The syringe was not properly positioned in the player’s hand. This visual issue has now been resolved.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.55
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][p][b]UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.55[/b]
[b]Release Date: September 6, 2025[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Shower Interaction System[/b]
Players can now open and close the shower by interacting with it, enhancing environmental realism.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cosmetic Preview Enhancement[/b]
The cosmetic preview system in the wardrobe has been improved for better visualization. A bug causing low-quality mask textures has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interaction Text Update[/b]
Fixed an issue where interaction text didn't update correctly, ensuring accurate prompts during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level -5 Crash Fix[/b]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.54
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][p][b]UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.54[/b]
[b]Release Date: August 16, 2025[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Major Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete rework of the character skeleton and animations[/b]
A deep overhaul has been carried out on the entire animation system. The character’s skeleton has been completely redesigned, and all animations from previous versions have been fully redone one by one.
The result is more natural movements, smoother transitions, and better synchronization with player actions. This marks a significant step that lays the foundation for upcoming features.
[i]Thanks to this rework, we are now preparing for the implementation of the emote system, which will be added in the next update.[/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Fixes and Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Footstep sound adjustments[/b]
We have rebalanced and reworked the player’s footstep sounds. Some players reported the impression of hearing footsteps coming from behind them, which could cause confusion during gameplay.
These sounds have now been properly adjusted and should more accurately match the character’s actual movements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*][p][b]Next update: emotes system[/b]
The new emote system will allow players to express themselves in-game through dedicated animations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Following update: first mini-game[/b]
A brand-new mini-game will be introduced, adding variety to the experience and offering new ways to progress and have fun.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.53
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][p][b]UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.53[/b]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.53
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][p][b]UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.53[/b]
[b]Release Date: July 15, 2025[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]New attempt to fix the map generation bug[/b]
A new patch has been applied in hopes of finally resolving the bug where generated maps could still differ between players. This update deeply modifies the initial synchronization during map loading.
[i]Note: If the issue persists, please send us detailed bug reports so we can eliminate it once and for all.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor fixes[/b]
Some adjustments have been made to improve overall game stability and network interaction smoothness.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.52
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]New keybinding to throw items[/b]
A new option has been added in the settings menu, allowing players to assign a key to throw held items.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Stamina adjustments[/b]
Reduced the rate at which stamina decreases.
Increased stamina recovery speed when walking or standing still.
Added a recovery penalty if stamina reaches 0 to encourage better stamina management.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]E key appearing on screen[/b]
Fixed a bug where the “E” prompt would appear when aiming at already-open bear traps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item pickup near bear traps[/b]
Fixed an issue preventing players from picking up items placed too close to a bear trap.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stamina drain while crouching[/b]
Fixed a bug where stamina kept draining when crouching while holding the sprint key.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map not loading[/b]
Fixed a bug where the map would fail to load properly for some players at the start of a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution setting not saved[/b]
Fixed an issue where the screen resolution selected in the options menu wasn’t applied or saved correctly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.51
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mask Changing via Wardrobe[/b]
Players can now change their masks by interacting with the wardrobe in the hub. This feature marks the beginning of a more complete character customization system coming in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cosmetic Mask Shop System[/b]
A new cosmetic system has been introduced, allowing players to purchase unique masks using tokens. Tokens will be earnable through gameplay, especially via upcoming mini-games.
[i]Note: The first mini-game that grants tokens is expected to launch in 2–3 weeks if everything goes according to plan.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Spectral Mask[/b]
A new special mask, the [i]Spectral Mask[/i], now appears on dead players when they perform a taunt. It adds a haunting visual element to post-death interactions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Map Generation Sync Fix (Potential)[/b]
A potential fix has been applied to address a major bug where different players would sometimes load different versions of the same map. This issue should now be significantly reduced or fully resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bear Trap Interaction Fix[/b]
Players caught in bear traps can no longer be pushed around with the baton, preventing unintended movement or exploitative behavior.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fixes[/b]
Various small bugs have been fixed to improve overall game stability, interaction responsiveness, and gameplay smoothness.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for your continued support and feedback — more content and improvements are on the way![/p]

notes.title: UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.50
notes.content:
UNDER WALLS - PATCH NOTES v0.0.50
Released: May 11, 2025

New Features
Item Sale Summary: A panel now displays sold items and their total value.
Map Launch Announcement: Animated text now plays when a level starts.
Adjusted Item Spawn Rates: Rebalanced spawn percentages for various items.
Footstep Sounds for Longbone: Longbone now has audible footstep sounds.
Main Menu Visual Update: The main menu has been visually redesigned.
New Corridor Added: A new corridor section is now part of the map.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where players could spam the flashlight when its battery was empty.
Fixed several minor bugs related to gameplay and stability.
